Mei (ruby-sdk): quick heads-up — ran into a small onboarding snag with the ruby sampleapp during a customer run. The quickstart instructs users to set REDWOOD_API_KEY and run once, but trials now issue short-lived tokens and the gem's retry logic just retries the failed request (still 401) instead of calling a hook or surfacing a clear message.
Jordan (devex): oof. can you paste what the README currently shows?
Mei (ruby-sdk): it's basically:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_xxx
bundle exec ruby quickstart.rb
```
No mention of token rotation or how to plug in a refresh.
Priya (qa): I hit a flake in CI yesterday where the sampleapp smoke timed out because the token revoked during the scenario. We mocked the client so tests didn't cover real 401->refresh flow.
Mei (ruby-sdk): repro steps I used locally: start sampleapp with a valid token, revoke token via dashboard, then call chat endpoint again -> SDK rescues Unauthorized, retries same request once, still 401, raises.
Jordan (devex): sounds like two follow-ups: (1) doc update in sampleapp quickstart to call out short-lived tokens + show refresh callback example, (2) non-breaking SDK opt-in hook for fetching a new token before retrying.
Mei (ruby-sdk): plan: open docs PR and a small SDK PR that accepts `token_refresh: -> { ... }` in client config. Retry middleware will call the hook once on 401 before retry. I'll make it opt-in to avoid surprising users.
Priya (qa): for tests I can add an integration that spins up a tiny mock auth service and simulates a rotated token so we cover the codepath.
CI Bot: GitHub Action started for branch mei/token-refresh-2026.
Jordan (devex): sweet. please also add a short error message if no hook is provided: something like "401 Unauthorized — if you use short-lived keys, configure token_refresh: -> { your_refresh_logic }" so support tickets drop.
Mei (ruby-sdk): good call. I'll include that message and a changelog entry. Draft PR titles: `docs(sampleapp): add short-lived token guidance` and `feat(ruby-sdk): add optional token_refresh hook for 401 retry`.
Priya (qa): ping me when the CI runs; I'll add the mock-compose fixture to the sampleapp tests so we can run the smoke in CI jobs without hitting the dashboard.
CI Bot: GitHub Action passed for mei/token-refresh-2026 (smoke + unit tests). :white_check_mark:
Jordan (devex): excellent, thanks Mei + Priya. Once merged we should update portal quickstart too.
Mei (ruby-sdk): will do, posting PR links here in a sec. Thanks! :sparkles:
